"""
PPO基础配置模块
定义所有可配置的超参数和实验设置

Author: PPO Research Team
Date: 2025-10-18
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Literal, Optional, Dict, Any
from enum import Enum


class PPOVariant(Enum):
    """PPO算法变体枚举"""
    CLIP = "clip"  # Clipped surrogate objective
    KL_PENALTY_FIXED = "kl_fixed"  # 固定KL惩罚
    KL_PENALTY_ADAPTIVE = "kl_adaptive"  # 自适应KL惩罚
    NO_CLIP_NO_PENALTY = "no_clip"  # 无裁剪无惩罚（消融实验）


class EnvType(Enum):
    """环境类型枚举"""
    MUJOCO = "mujoco"
    ATARI = "atari"
    CLASSIC = "classic"


@dataclass
class NetworkConfig:
    """神经网络架构配置"""
    # Actor网络配置
    actor_hidden_sizes: tuple = (64, 64)
    actor_activation: str = "tanh"  # tanh, relu, elu
    
    # Critic网络配置
    critic_hidden_sizes: tuple = (64, 64)
    critic_activation: str = "tanh"
    
    # 网络初始化

    # 输出层初始化（论文推荐）
    policy_output_scale: float = 0.01  # 小值初始化策略输出
    value_output_scale: float = 1.0


@dataclass
class PPOConfig:
    """PPO算法核心配置"""
    # ========== 基础配置 ==========
    env_name: str = "HalfCheetah-v4"
    env_type: EnvType = EnvType.MUJOCO
    num_envs: int = 1  # 并行环境数量
    seed: int = 42
    
    # ========== PPO变体选择 ==========
    ppo_variant: PPOVariant = PPOVariant.CLIP
    
    # ========== Clipped Surrogate参数 ==========
    clip_epsilon: float = 0.2  # 论文默认值
    
    # ========== KL Penalty参数 ==========
    kl_target: float = 0.01  # 目标KL散度
    kl_beta_init: float = 1.0  # 初始KL系数
    kl_beta_min: float = 0.1
    kl_beta_max: float = 10.0
    kl_adapt_factor: float = 2.0  # β调整因子
    
    # ========== 训练超参数 ==========
    total_timesteps: int = 1_000_000  # 总训练步数
    horizon: int = 2048  # 每次rollout的步数（MuJoCo: 2048, Atari: 128）
    num_epochs: int = 10  # 每次更新的epoch数（MuJoCo: 10, Atari: 3-4）
    minibatch_size: int = 64  # Minibatch大小
    
    # ========== 学习率 ==========
    learning_rate: float = 3e-4
    lr_schedule: str = "linear"  # constant, linear, cosine
    
    # ========== 折扣因子 ==========
    gamma: float = 0.99  # 折扣因子
    gae_lambda: float = 0.95  # GAE参数λ
    
    # ========== 损失函数权重 ==========
    value_loss_coef: float = 0.5  # 价值函数损失系数 c1
    entropy_coef: float = 0.01  # 熵正则化系数 c2
    
    # ========== 优化器配置 ==========
    optimizer: str = "adam"  # adam, sgd, rmsprop
    max_grad_norm: float = 0.5  # 梯度裁剪

    # ========== 值函数配置 ==========
    normalize_advantage: bool = True  # 标准化优势函数
    clip_value_loss: bool = True  # 是否裁剪价值损失

    # ========== 早停机制 ==========

    # ========== 网络配置 ==========
    network: NetworkConfig = field(default_factory=NetworkConfig)
    
    # ========== 日志与保存 ==========
    log_interval: int = 10  # 每N次更新记录日志
    save_interval: int = 100  # 每N次更新保存模型
    eval_interval: int = 50  # 每N次更新评估模型
    num_eval_episodes: int = 10  # 评估时的episode数
    
    # ========== 路径配置 ==========
    log_dir: str = "./logs"
    checkpoint_dir: str = "./checkpoints"
    result_dir: str = "./results"
    
    # ========== 设备配置 ==========
    device: str = "auto"  # auto, cpu, cuda
    
    # ========== 实验标识 ==========
    experiment_name: str = "ppo_baseline"
    run_name: Optional[str] = None  # 自动生成如果为None

    def __post_init__(self):
        """初始化后验证配置合法性"""
        # 验证基本参数
        assert self.clip_epsilon > 0, "clip_epsilon必须大于0"
        assert self.gamma >= 0 and self.gamma <= 1, "gamma必须在[0,1]"
        assert self.gae_lambda >= 0 and self.gae_lambda <= 1, "gae_lambda必须在[0,1]"
        assert self.horizon > 0, "horizon必须大于0"
        assert self.num_epochs > 0, "num_epochs必须大于0"

        # 验证batch配置
        total_batch_size = self.horizon * self.num_envs
        assert total_batch_size % self.minibatch_size == 0, \
            f"batch_size ({total_batch_size}) 必须能被minibatch_size ({self.minibatch_size}) 整除"
        
        # 自动生成run_name
        if self.run_name is None:
            from datetime import datetime
            timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
            self.run_name = f"{self.experiment_name}_{self.ppo_variant.value}_{timestamp}"

    def get_num_minibatches(self) -> int:
        """计算每个epoch的minibatch数量"""
        total_batch_size = self.horizon * self.num_envs
        return total_batch_size // self.minibatch_size
    
    def get_num_updates(self) -> int:
        """计算总更新次数"""
        return self.total_timesteps // (self.horizon * self.num_envs)
    
    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """转换为字典格式（用于保存）"""
        config_dict = {}
        for key, value in self.__dict__.items():
            if isinstance(value, Enum):
                config_dict[key] = value.value
            elif isinstance(value, NetworkConfig):
                config_dict[key] = value.__dict__
            else:

"""
Actor-Critic神经网络实现
支持离散和连续动作空间

Author: PPO Research Team
Date: 2025-10-18
"""

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import numpy as np
from typing import Tuple, Optional
from torch.distributions import Categorical, Normal


def init_weights(module: nn.Module, gain: float = 1.0, method: str = "orthogonal") -> None:
    """
    初始化神经网络权重
    
    Args:
        module: 要初始化的模块
        gain: 初始化增益
        method: 初始化方法 (orthogonal, xavier, kaiming)
    """
    if isinstance(module, (nn.Linear, nn.Conv2d)):
        if method == "orthogonal":
            nn.init.orthogonal_(module.weight, gain=gain)
        elif method == "xavier":
            nn.init.xavier_uniform_(module.weight, gain=gain)
        elif method == "kaiming":
            nn.init.kaiming_uniform_(module.weight, nonlinearity='relu')
        
        if module.bias is not None:
            nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)


def create_mlp(
    input_dim: int,
    output_dim: int,
    hidden_sizes: Tuple[int, ...],
    activation: str = "tanh",
    output_activation: Optional[str] = None
) -> nn.Sequential:
    """
    创建多层感知机（MLP）
    
    Args:
        input_dim: 输入维度
        output_dim: 输出维度
        hidden_sizes: 隐藏层大小元组
        activation: 激活函数类型
        output_activation: 输出层激活函数
        
    Returns:
        MLP网络
    """
    # 激活函数映射
    activation_map = {
        "tanh": nn.Tanh(),
        "relu": nn.ReLU(),
        "elu": nn.ELU(),
        "leaky_relu": nn.LeakyReLU(0.2)
    }
    
    layers = []
    prev_size = input_dim
    
    # 构建隐藏层
    for hidden_size in hidden_sizes:
        layers.append(nn.Linear(prev_size, hidden_size))
        layers.append(activation_map[activation])
        prev_size = hidden_size
    
    # 输出层
    layers.append(nn.Linear(prev_size, output_dim))
    if output_activation is not None:
        layers.append(activation_map[output_activation])
    
    return nn.Sequential(*layers)


class ActorContinuous(nn.Module):
    """
    连续动作空间的Actor网络（高斯策略）
    输出均值和对数标准差
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        obs_dim: int,
        action_dim: int,
        hidden_sizes: Tuple[int, ...] = (64, 64),
        activation: str = "tanh",
        log_std_init: float = 0.0
    ):
        """
        Args:
            obs_dim: 观测空间维度
            action_dim: 动作空间维度
            hidden_sizes: 隐藏层配置
            activation: 激活函数
            log_std_init: 对数标准差初始值
        """
        super().__init__()
        
        self.action_dim = action_dim
        
        # 均值网络
        self.mean_net = create_mlp(
            obs_dim, action_dim, hidden_sizes, activation
        )
        
        # 对数标准差（可学习参数）
        self.log_std = nn.Parameter(
            torch.ones(action_dim) * log_std_init
        )
        
        # 初始化权重（论文推荐小值初始化输出层）
        self.apply(lambda m: init_weights(m, gain=1.0))
        init_weights(self.mean_net[-1], gain=0.01, method="orthogonal")
    
    def forward(self, obs: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        前向传播
        
        Args:
            obs: 观测 [batch, obs_dim]
            
        Returns:
            mean: 动作均值 [batch, action_dim]
            std: 动作标准差 [batch, action_dim]
        """
        mean = self.mean_net(obs)
        std = torch.exp(self.log_std).expand_as(mean)
        return mean, std
    
    def get_distribution(self, obs: torch.Tensor) -> Normal:
        """获取动作分布"""
        mean, std = self.forward(obs)
        return Normal(mean, std)
    
    def sample_action(self, obs: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        采样动作
        
        Returns:
            action: 采样的动作
            log_prob: 对数概率
        """
        dist = self.get_distribution(obs)
        action = dist.sample()
        log_prob = dist.log_prob(action).sum(dim=-1)
        return action, log_prob
    
    def evaluate_actions(
        self, 
        obs: torch.Tensor, 
        actions: torch.Tensor
    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        评估已有动作的对数概率和熵
        
        Returns:
            log_probs: 对数概率
            entropy: 熵
        """
        dist = self.get_distribution(obs)
        log_probs = dist.log_prob(actions).sum(dim=-1)
        entropy = dist.entropy().sum(dim=-1)
        return log_probs, entropy


class ActorDiscrete(nn.Module):
    """
    离散动作空间的Actor网络（Categorical策略）
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        obs_dim: int,
        action_dim: int,
        hidden_sizes: Tuple[int, ...] = (64, 64),
        activation: str = "tanh"
    ):
        """
        Args:
            obs_dim: 观测空间维度
            action_dim: 动作空间大小
            hidden_sizes: 隐藏层配置
            activation: 激活函数
        """
        super().__init__()
        
        self.action_dim = action_dim
        
        # Logits网络
        self.logits_net = create_mlp(
            obs_dim, action_dim, hidden_sizes, activation
        )
        
        # 初始化权重
        self.apply(lambda m: init_weights(m, gain=1.0))
        init_weights(self.logits_net[-1], gain=0.01, method="orthogonal")
    
    def forward(self, obs: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        前向传播
        
        Args:
            obs: 观测 [batch, obs_dim]
            
        Returns:
            logits: 动作logits [batch, action_dim]
        """
        return self.logits_net(obs)
    
    def get_distribution(self, obs: torch.Tensor) -> Categorical:
        """获取动作分布"""
        logits = self.forward(obs)
        return Categorical(logits=logits)
    
    def sample_action(self, obs: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        采样动作
        
        Returns:
            action: 采样的动作
            log_prob: 对数概率
        """
        dist = self.get_distribution(obs)
        action = dist.sample()
        log_prob = dist.log_prob(action)
        return action, log_prob
    
    def evaluate_actions(
        self, 
        obs: torch.Tensor, 
        actions: torch.Tensor
    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        评估已有动作的对数概率和熵
        
        Returns:
            log_probs: 对数概率
            entropy: 熵
        """
        dist = self.get_distribution(obs)
        log_probs = dist.log_prob(actions)
        entropy = dist.entropy()
        return log_probs, entropy


class Critic(nn.Module):
    """
    Critic网络（价值函数V(s)）
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        obs_dim: int,
        hidden_sizes: Tuple[int, ...] = (64, 64),
        activation: str = "tanh"
    ):
        """
        Args:
            obs_dim: 观测空间维度
            hidden_sizes: 隐藏层配置
            activation: 激活函数
        """
        super().__init__()
        
        self.value_net = create_mlp(
            obs_dim, 1, hidden_sizes, activation
        )
        
        # 初始化权重
        self.apply(lambda m: init_weights(m, gain=1.0))
        init_weights(self.value_net[-1], gain=1.0, method="orthogonal")
    
    def forward(self, obs: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        前向传播
        
        Args:
            obs: 观测 [batch, obs_dim]
            
        Returns:
            value: 状态价值 [batch]
        """
        return self.value_net(obs).squeeze(-1)


class ActorCritic(nn.Module):
    """
    完整的Actor-Critic网络
    自动根据动作空间类型选择Actor
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        obs_dim: int,
        action_space,  # gym.Space
        hidden_sizes_actor: Tuple[int, ...] = (64, 64),
        hidden_sizes_critic: Tuple[int, ...] = (64, 64),
        activation: str = "tanh"
    ):
        """
        Args:
            obs_dim: 观测空间维度
            action_space: Gym动作空间
            hidden_sizes_actor: Actor隐藏层
            hidden_sizes_critic: Critic隐藏层
            activation: 激活函数
        """
        super().__init__()
        
        # 判断动作空间类型
        from gymnasium.spaces import Box, Discrete
        
        if isinstance(action_space, Box):
            # 连续动作空间
            self.is_continuous = True
            action_dim = action_space.shape[0]
            self.actor = ActorContinuous(
                obs_dim, action_dim, hidden_sizes_actor, activation
            )
        elif isinstance(action_space, Discrete):
            # 离散动作空间
            self.is_continuous = False
            action_dim = action_space.n
            self.actor = ActorDiscrete(
                obs_dim, action_dim, hidden_sizes_actor, activation
            )
        else:
            raise NotImplementedError(f"不支持的动作空间类型: {type(action_space)}")
        
        # Critic网络
        self.critic = Critic(obs_dim, hidden_sizes_critic, activation)
    
    def get_value(self, obs: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        """获取状态价值"""
        return self.critic(obs)
    
    def get_action_and_value(
        self, 
        obs: torch.Tensor, 
        deterministic: bool = False
    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        获取动作和价值（用于采样）
        
        Args:
            obs: 观测
            deterministic: 是否确定性采样（评估时使用）
            
        Returns:
            action: 动作
            log_prob: 对数概率
            value: 状态价值
        """
        if deterministic:
            # 确定性动作
            if self.is_continuous:
                mean, _ = self.actor(obs)
                action = mean
            else:
                logits = self.actor(obs)
                action = torch.argmax(logits, dim=-1)
            # 重新计算log_prob
            log_prob, _ = self.actor.evaluate_actions(obs, action)
        else:
            # 随机采样
            action, log_prob = self.actor.sample_action(obs)
        
        value = self.critic(obs)
        return action, log_prob, value
    
    def evaluate_actions(
        self, 
        obs: torch.Tensor, 
        actions: torch.Tensor
    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        评估给定观测和动作（用于训练）
        
        Returns:
            values: 状态价值
            log_probs: 对数概率
            entropy: 熵
        """
        log_probs, entropy = self.actor.evaluate_actions(obs, actions)
        values = self.critic(obs)
        return values, log_probs, entropy

"""
Generalized Advantage Estimation (GAE) 实现
论文: High-Dimensional Continuous Control Using Generalized Advantage Estimation

Author: PPO Research Team
Date: 2025-10-18
"""

import torch
import numpy as np
from typing import Tuple


def compute_gae(
    rewards: torch.Tensor,
    values: torch.Tensor,
    dones: torch.Tensor,
    next_value: torch.Tensor,
    gamma: float = 0.99,
    gae_lambda: float = 0.95
) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    """
    计算Generalized Advantage Estimation (GAE)
    
    GAE公式:
        δ_t = r_t + γ·V(s_{t+1}) - V(s_t)
        A_t = Σ(γλ)^l·δ_{t+l}
    
    Args:
        rewards: 奖励序列 [T, num_envs]
        values: 价值估计 [T, num_envs]
        dones: 终止标志 [T, num_envs]
        next_value: 下一状态的价值 [num_envs]
        gamma: 折扣因子
        gae_lambda: GAE的λ参数
        
    Returns:
        advantages: 优势函数 [T, num_envs]
        returns: 回报 [T, num_envs]
    """
    num_steps = rewards.shape[0]
    num_envs = rewards.shape[1]
    
    # 初始化
    advantages = torch.zeros_like(rewards)
    last_gae_lam = 0
    
    # 从后向前计算GAE
    for t in reversed(range(num_steps)):
        if t == num_steps - 1:
            # 最后一步，使用next_value
            next_value_t = next_value
        else:
            # 否则使用下一步的value
            next_value_t = values[t + 1]
        
        # TD误差: δ_t = r_t + γ·V(s_{t+1})·(1-done) - V(s_t)
        # (1-done)处理episode边界
        delta = rewards[t] + gamma * next_value_t * (1 - dones[t]) - values[t]
        
        # GAE: A_t = δ_t + γλ·(1-done)·A_{t+1}
        advantages[t] = last_gae_lam = (
            delta + gamma * gae_lambda * (1 - dones[t]) * last_gae_lam
        )
    
    # 计算回报: R_t = A_t + V(s_t)
    returns = advantages + values
    
    return advantages, returns


def compute_gae_vectorized(
    rewards: np.ndarray,
    values: np.ndarray,
    dones: np.ndarray,
    next_value: np.ndarray,
    gamma: float = 0.99,
    gae_lambda: float = 0.95
) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """
    计算GAE的NumPy向量化版本（更快）
    
    Args:
        rewards: [T, num_envs]
        values: [T, num_envs]
        dones: [T, num_envs]
        next_value: [num_envs]
        gamma: 折扣因子
        gae_lambda: GAE参数
        
    Returns:
        advantages: [T, num_envs]
        returns: [T, num_envs]
    """
    num_steps = len(rewards)
    
    # 构建完整的value序列 [T+1, num_envs]
    values_extended = np.concatenate([values, next_value[None, :]], axis=0)
    
    # 初始化
    advantages = np.zeros_like(rewards)
    last_gae_lam = 0
    
    # 从后向前计算
    for t in reversed(range(num_steps)):
        next_non_terminal = 1.0 - dones[t]
        next_values = values_extended[t + 1]
        
        # TD误差
        delta = rewards[t] + gamma * next_values * next_non_terminal - values[t]
        
        # GAE
        advantages[t] = last_gae_lam = (
            delta + gamma * gae_lambda * next_non_terminal * last_gae_lam
        )
    
    returns = advantages + values
    return advantages, returns


class GAEBuffer:
    """
    专门用于GAE的经验缓冲区
    存储rollout数据并计算优势函数
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        buffer_size: int,
        num_envs: int,
        obs_dim: int,
        action_dim: int,
        gamma: float = 0.99,
        gae_lambda: float = 0.95,
        device: str = "cpu"
    ):
        """
        Args:
            buffer_size: 缓冲区大小（horizon）
            num_envs: 并行环境数量
            obs_dim: 观测维度
            action_dim: 动作维度
            gamma: 折扣因子
            gae_lambda: GAE参数
            device: 设备
        """
        self.buffer_size = buffer_size
        self.num_envs = num_envs
        self.gamma = gamma
        self.gae_lambda = gae_lambda
        self.device = device
        
        # 分配存储空间
        self.observations = np.zeros((buffer_size, num_envs, obs_dim), dtype=np.float32)
        self.actions = np.zeros((buffer_size, num_envs, action_dim), dtype=np.float32)
        self.rewards = np.zeros((buffer_size, num_envs), dtype=np.float32)
        self.values = np.zeros((buffer_size, num_envs), dtype=np.float32)
        self.log_probs = np.zeros((buffer_size, num_envs), dtype=np.float32)
        self.dones = np.zeros((buffer_size, num_envs), dtype=np.float32)
        
        # GAE计算结果
        self.advantages = np.zeros((buffer_size, num_envs), dtype=np.float32)
        self.returns = np.zeros((buffer_size, num_envs), dtype=np.float32)
        
        self.ptr = 0  # 当前指针
        self.path_start_idx = 0  # 路径起始索引
    
    def add(
        self,
        obs: np.ndarray,
        action: np.ndarray,
        reward: np.ndarray,
        value: np.ndarray,
        log_prob: np.ndarray,
        done: np.ndarray
    ) -> None:
        """
        添加一步经验
        
        Args:
            obs: 观测 [num_envs, obs_dim]
            action: 动作 [num_envs, action_dim]
            reward: 奖励 [num_envs]
            value: 价值 [num_envs]
            log_prob: 对数概率 [num_envs]
            done: 终止标志 [num_envs]
        """
        assert self.ptr < self.buffer_size, "缓冲区已满"
        
        self.observations[self.ptr] = obs
        self.actions[self.ptr] = action
        self.rewards[self.ptr] = reward
        self.values[self.ptr] = value
        self.log_probs[self.ptr] = log_prob
        self.dones[self.ptr] = done
        
        self.ptr += 1
    
    def compute_advantages(self, next_value: np.ndarray) -> None:
        """
        计算优势函数和回报
        
        Args:
            next_value: 最后一步的下一状态价值 [num_envs]
        """
        assert self.ptr == self.buffer_size, f"缓冲区未满: {self.ptr}/{self.buffer_size}"
        
        # 使用向量化版本计算GAE
        self.advantages, self.returns = compute_gae_vectorized(
            self.rewards,
            self.values,
            self.dones,
            next_value,
            self.gamma,
            self.gae_lambda
        )
    
    def get(self) -> dict:
        """
        获取所有数据（用于训练）
        
        Returns:
            包含所有数据的字典
        """
        assert self.ptr == self.buffer_size, "缓冲区未满"
        
        # 展平数据 [buffer_size * num_envs, ...]
        batch_size = self.buffer_size * self.num_envs
        
        data = {
            "observations": torch.FloatTensor(self.observations.reshape(batch_size, -1)).to(self.device),
            "actions": torch.FloatTensor(self.actions.reshape(batch_size, -1)).to(self.device),
            "log_probs": torch.FloatTensor(self.log_probs.reshape(batch_size)).to(self.device),
            "values": torch.FloatTensor(self.values.reshape(batch_size)).to(self.device),
            "advantages": torch.FloatTensor(self.advantages.reshape(batch_size)).to(self.device),
            "returns": torch.FloatTensor(self.returns.reshape(batch_size)).to(self.device),
        }
        
        return data
    
    def reset(self) -> None:
        """重置缓冲区"""
        self.ptr = 0
        self.path_start_idx = 0


# ========== 单元测试 ==========

def test_gae():
    """测试GAE计算的正确性"""
    print("=== 测试GAE计算 ===")
    
    # 简单的测试用例
    T = 5
    num_envs = 2
    gamma = 0.99
    gae_lambda = 0.95
    
    # 构造测试数据
    rewards = torch.tensor([
        [1.0, 2.0],
        [1.0, 2.0],
        [1.0, 2.0],
        [1.0, 2.0],
        [1.0, 2.0],
    ])
    
    values = torch.tensor([
        [0.5, 1.0],
        [0.6, 1.1],
        [0.7, 1.2],
        [0.8, 1.3],
        [0.9, 1.4],
    ])
    
    dones = torch.zeros(T, num_envs)
    next_value = torch.tensor([1.0, 1.5])
    
    # 计算GAE
    advantages, returns = compute_gae(
        rewards, values, dones, next_value, gamma, gae_lambda
    )
    
    print(f"Advantages shape: {advantages.shape}")
    print(f"Returns shape: {returns.shape}")
    print(f"Advantages[0]: {advantages[0]}")
    print(f"Returns[0]: {returns[0]}")
    
    # 验证基本性质
    assert advantages.shape == (T, num_envs), "形状错误"
    assert returns.shape == (T, num_envs), "形状错误"
    assert torch.allclose(returns, advantages + values), "Return计算错误"
    
    print("✅ GAE测试通过!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_gae()

"""
PPO (Proximal Policy Optimization) 核心算法实现
支持多种变体：Clipped, KL Penalty (Fixed/Adaptive)

论文: Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms (Schulman et al., 2017)

Author: PPO Research Team
Date: 2025-10-18
"""

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
import numpy as np
from typing import Dict, Optional, Tuple
from loguru import logger

from configs.base_config import PPOConfig, PPOVariant
from models.networks import ActorCritic
from algorithms.gae import GAEBuffer


class PPOAgent:
    """
    PPO算法的主要实现类
    支持论文中的所有变体和消融实验
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        config: PPOConfig,
        obs_space,
        action_space,
        device: str = "cpu"
    ):
        """
        Args:
            config: PPO配置
            obs_space: 观测空间
            action_space: 动作空间
            device: 计算设备
        """
        self.config = config
        self.device = device
        
        # 提取关键参数
        self.ppo_variant = config.ppo_variant
        self.clip_epsilon = config.clip_epsilon
        self.value_loss_coef = config.value_loss_coef
        self.entropy_coef = config.entropy_coef
        self.max_grad_norm = config.max_grad_norm
        self.normalize_advantage = config.normalize_advantage
        self.clip_value_loss = config.clip_value_loss
        
        # KL散度相关参数（用于KL Penalty和早停）
        self.kl_target = config.kl_target
        self.kl_beta = config.kl_beta_init  # 当前KL系数（自适应）
        self.kl_beta_min = config.kl_beta_min
        self.kl_beta_max = config.kl_beta_max
        self.kl_adapt_factor = config.kl_adapt_factor
        
        # 早停机制
        self.use_early_stopping = config.use_early_stopping
        self.target_kl = config.target_kl
        
        # 创建Actor-Critic网络
        obs_dim = np.prod(obs_space.shape)
        self.actor_critic = ActorCritic(
            obs_dim=obs_dim,
            action_space=action_space,
            hidden_sizes_actor=config.network.actor_hidden_sizes,
            hidden_sizes_critic=config.network.critic_hidden_sizes,
            activation=config.network.actor_activation
        ).to(device)
        
        # 创建优化器
        self.optimizer = optim.Adam(
            self.actor_critic.parameters(),
            lr=config.learning_rate,
            eps=config.adam_epsilon
        )
        
        # 统计信息
        self.update_count = 0
        
        logger.info(f"🤖 PPO Agent 初始化完成")
        logger.info(f"   变体: {self.ppo_variant.value}")
        logger.info(f"   Clip ε: {self.clip_epsilon}")
        logger.info(f"   设备: {device}")
    
    def compute_policy_loss(
        self,
        obs: torch.Tensor,
        actions: torch.Tensor,
        old_log_probs: torch.Tensor,
        advantages: torch.Tensor,
        entropy: torch.Tensor
    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, float]]:
        """
        计算策略损失（支持多种变体）
        
        Args:
            obs: 观测
            actions: 动作
            old_log_probs: 旧策略的对数概率
            advantages: 优势函数
            entropy: 熵
            
        Returns:
            loss: 策略损失
            info: 诊断信息
        """
        # 获取新策略的对数概率
        _, new_log_probs, _ = self.actor_critic.evaluate_actions(obs, actions)
        
        # 计算概率比 r_t = π_θ(a|s) / π_θ_old(a|s)
        ratio = torch.exp(new_log_probs - old_log_probs)
        
        # 计算KL散度（近似）
        # KL(old||new) ≈ E[(old_log_prob - new_log_prob)]
        with torch.no_grad():
            approx_kl = (old_log_probs - new_log_probs).mean().item()
        
        info = {
            "ratio_mean": ratio.mean().item(),
            "ratio_min": ratio.min().item(),
            "ratio_max": ratio.max().item(),
            "approx_kl": approx_kl,
        }
        
        # 根据变体选择不同的损失函数
        if self.ppo_variant == PPOVariant.CLIP:
            # ========== Clipped Surrogate Objective ==========
            # L^CLIP = E[min(r_t·A_t, clip(r_t, 1-ε, 1+ε)·A_t)]
            
            surr1 = ratio * advantages
            surr2 = torch.clamp(
                ratio, 
                1.0 - self.clip_epsilon, 
                1.0 + self.clip_epsilon
            ) * advantages
            
            policy_loss = -torch.min(surr1, surr2).mean()
            
            # 统计裁剪比例
            with torch.no_grad():
                clip_fraction = ((ratio - 1.0).abs() > self.clip_epsilon).float().mean().item()
            info["clip_fraction"] = clip_fraction
            
        elif self.ppo_variant == PPOVariant.KL_PENALTY_FIXED:
            # ========== 固定KL惩罚 ==========
            # L = r_t·A_t - β·KL
            
            kl_penalty = approx_kl * self.kl_beta
            policy_loss = -(ratio * advantages).mean() + kl_penalty
            info["kl_penalty"] = kl_penalty
            
        elif self.ppo_variant == PPOVariant.KL_PENALTY_ADAPTIVE:
            # ========== 自适应KL惩罚 ==========
            # L = r_t·A_t - β·KL
            # β根据KL散度动态调整
            
            kl_penalty = approx_kl * self.kl_beta
            policy_loss = -(ratio * advantages).mean() + kl_penalty
            
            # 更新β（在训练循环结束后调用）
            info["kl_penalty"] = kl_penalty
            info["kl_beta"] = self.kl_beta
            
        else:  # NO_CLIP_NO_PENALTY
            # ========== 无裁剪无惩罚（消融实验） ==========
            # L = r_t·A_t
            
            policy_loss = -(ratio * advantages).mean()
        
        # 添加熵正则化
        entropy_loss = -entropy.mean() * self.entropy_coef
        policy_loss = policy_loss + entropy_loss
        
        info["entropy"] = entropy.mean().item()
        info["policy_loss"] = policy_loss.item()
        
        return policy_loss, info
    
    def compute_value_loss(
        self,
        obs: torch.Tensor,
        returns: torch.Tensor,
        old_values: torch.Tensor
    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, float]]:
        """
        计算价值函数损失
        
        Args:
            obs: 观测
            returns: 回报
            old_values: 旧的价值估计
            
        Returns:
            loss: 价值损失
            info: 诊断信息
        """
        # 获取新的价值估计
        new_values = self.actor_critic.get_value(obs)
        
        if self.clip_value_loss:
            # ========== 裁剪价值损失 ==========
            # 防止价值函数更新过大
            
            value_pred_clipped = old_values + torch.clamp(
                new_values - old_values,
                -self.config.value_clip_epsilon,
                self.config.value_clip_epsilon
            )
            
            value_loss_unclipped = (new_values - returns).pow(2)
            value_loss_clipped = (value_pred_clipped - returns).pow(2)
            value_loss = 0.5 * torch.max(value_loss_unclipped, value_loss_clipped).mean()
        else:
            # ========== 标准MSE损失 ==========
            value_loss = 0.5 * (new_values - returns).pow(2).mean()
        
        value_loss = value_loss * self.value_loss_coef
        
        info = {
            "value_loss": value_loss.item(),
            "value_mean": new_values.mean().item(),
            "return_mean": returns.mean().item(),
        }
        
        return value_loss, info
    
    def update(self, buffer: GAEBuffer) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """
        使用缓冲区数据更新策略
        
        Args:
            buffer: 包含rollout数据的GAE缓冲区
            
        Returns:
            训练统计信息
        """
        # 获取数据
        data = buffer.get()
        obs = data["observations"]
        actions = data["actions"]
        old_log_probs = data["log_probs"]
        old_values = data["values"]
        advantages = data["advantages"]
        returns = data["returns"]
        
        # 标准化优势函数（重要！）
        if self.normalize_advantage:
            advantages = (advantages - advantages.mean()) / (advantages.std() + 1e-8)
        
        # 汇总统计信息
        update_info = {
            "total_policy_loss": 0.0,
            "total_value_loss": 0.0,
            "total_loss": 0.0,
            "approx_kl": 0.0,
            "entropy": 0.0,
            "clip_fraction": 0.0,
        }
        
        batch_size = len(obs)
        num_minibatches = batch_size // self.config.minibatch_size
        
        # 多个epoch的训练
        for epoch in range(self.config.num_epochs):
            # 随机打乱数据
            indices = torch.randperm(batch_size)
            
            # 早停检查
            if self.use_early_stopping and update_info["approx_kl"] > self.target_kl:
                logger.info(f"   Early stopping at epoch {epoch} due to KL divergence")
                break
            
            # Minibatch训练
            for start in range(0, batch_size, self.config.minibatch_size):
                end = start + self.config.minibatch_size
                mb_indices = indices[start:end]
                
                # 提取minibatch
                mb_obs = obs[mb_indices]
                mb_actions = actions[mb_indices]
                mb_old_log_probs = old_log_probs[mb_indices]
                mb_old_values = old_values[mb_indices]
                mb_advantages = advantages[mb_indices]
                mb_returns = returns[mb_indices]
                
                # 前向传播
                values, log_probs, entropy = self.actor_critic.evaluate_actions(
                    mb_obs, mb_actions
                )
                
                # 计算策略损失
                policy_loss, policy_info = self.compute_policy_loss(
                    mb_obs, mb_actions, mb_old_log_probs, mb_advantages, entropy
                )
                
                # 计算价值损失
                value_loss, value_info = self.compute_value_loss(
                    mb_obs, mb_returns, mb_old_values
                )
                
                # 总损失
                loss = policy_loss + value_loss
                
                # 反向传播和优化
                self.optimizer.zero_grad()
                loss.backward()
                
                # 梯度裁剪
                grad_norm = nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(
                    self.actor_critic.parameters(), 
                    self.max_grad_norm
                )
                
                self.optimizer.step()
                
                # 累积统计信息
                update_info["total_policy_loss"] += policy_info["policy_loss"]
                update_info["total_value_loss"] += value_info["value_loss"]
                update_info["total_loss"] += loss.item()
                update_info["approx_kl"] += policy_info["approx_kl"]
                update_info["entropy"] += policy_info["entropy"]
                if "clip_fraction" in policy_info:
                    update_info["clip_fraction"] += policy_info["clip_fraction"]
                update_info["grad_norm"] = grad_norm.item()
        
        # 平均化统计信息
        num_updates = self.config.num_epochs * num_minibatches
        for key in update_info:
            if key != "grad_norm":  # grad_norm保留最后一次的值
                update_info[key] /= num_updates
        
        # 自适应KL系数调整
        if self.ppo_variant == PPOVariant.KL_PENALTY_ADAPTIVE:
            self._update_kl_beta(update_info["approx_kl"])
            update_info["kl_beta"] = self.kl_beta
        
        self.update_count += 1
        return update_info
    
    def _update_kl_beta(self, kl: float) -> None:
        """
        自适应调整KL惩罚系数β
        
        如果KL过大，增大β；如果KL过小，减小β
        
        Args:
            kl: 当前KL散度
        """
        if kl > 2.0 * self.kl_target:
            # KL过大，增大β以增强约束
            self.kl_beta = min(self.kl_beta * self.kl_adapt_factor, self.kl_beta_max)
        elif kl < 0.5 * self.kl_target:
            # KL过小，减小β以允许更大步长
            self.kl_beta = max(self.kl_beta / self.kl_adapt_factor, self.kl_beta_min)
    
    def get_action(
        self, 
        obs: np.ndarray, 
        deterministic: bool = False
    ) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        """
        根据观测获取动作（用于环境交互）
        
        Args:
            obs: 观测 [num_envs, obs_dim]
            deterministic: 是否使用确定性策略
            
        Returns:
            action: 动作
            log_prob: 对数概率
            value: 状态价值
        """
        with torch.no_grad():
            obs_tensor = torch.FloatTensor(obs).to(self.device)
            action, log_prob, value = self.actor_critic.get_action_and_value(
                obs_tensor, deterministic
            )
            
            return (
                action.cpu().numpy(),
                log_prob.cpu().numpy(),
                value.cpu().numpy()
            )
    
    def save(self, path: str) -> None:
        """保存模型"""
        torch.save({
            "actor_critic": self.actor_critic.state_dict(),
            "optimizer": self.optimizer.state_dict(),
            "update_count": self.update_count,
            "kl_beta": self.kl_beta,
            "config": self.config.to_dict(),
        }, path)
        logger.info(f"💾 模型已保存到: {path}")
    
    def load(self, path: str) -> None:
        """加载模型"""
        checkpoint = torch.load(path, map_location=self.device)
        self.actor_critic.load_state_dict(checkpoint["actor_critic"])
        self.optimizer.load_state_dict(checkpoint["optimizer"])
        self.update_count = checkpoint["update_count"]
        self.kl_beta = checkpoint.get("kl_beta", self.kl_beta)
        logger.info(f"📂 模型已从 {path} 加载")

"""
PPO训练循环主程序
整合数据收集、策略更新、日志记录和模型保存

Author: PPO Research Team
Date: 2025-10-18
"""

import time
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional, Dict, List
from loguru import logger
from tqdm import tqdm

import gymnasium as gym
from torch.utils.tensorboard import SummaryWriter

from configs.base_config import PPOConfig
from algorithms.ppo_agent import PPOAgent
from algorithms.gae import GAEBuffer


class PPOTrainer:
    """
    PPO训练器
    负责完整的训练流程：环境交互、数据收集、策略更新、评估和日志
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        config: PPOConfig,
        env_fn=None,  # 环境创建函数
        device: str = "cpu"
    ):
        """
        Args:
            config: PPO配置
            env_fn: 环境创建函数，如果为None则使用默认gym.make
            device: 计算设备
        """
        self.config = config
        self.device = device
        
        # 创建环境
        if env_fn is None:
            env_fn = lambda: gym.make(config.env_name)
        
        # 向量化环境
        from gymnasium.vector import SyncVectorEnv
        self.env = SyncVectorEnv([
            env_fn for _ in range(config.num_envs)
        ])
        self.eval_env = env_fn()  # 单独的评估环境
        
        # 获取空间信息
        obs_space = self.env.single_observation_space
        action_space = self.env.single_action_space
        
        logger.info(f"🌍 环境初始化完成")
        logger.info(f"   名称: {config.env_name}")
        logger.info(f"   并行数: {config.num_envs}")
        logger.info(f"   观测空间: {obs_space}")
        logger.info(f"   动作空间: {action_space}")
        
        # 创建PPO Agent
        self.agent = PPOAgent(
            config=config,
            obs_space=obs_space,
            action_space=action_space,
            device=device
        )
        
        # 创建GAE缓冲区
        obs_dim = np.prod(obs_space.shape)
        action_dim = np.prod(action_space.shape) if hasattr(action_space, 'shape') else 1
        
        self.buffer = GAEBuffer(
            buffer_size=config.horizon,
            num_envs=config.num_envs,
            obs_dim=obs_dim,
            action_dim=action_dim,
            gamma=config.gamma,
            gae_lambda=config.gae_lambda,
            device=device
        )
        
        # 训练统计
        self.global_step = 0
        self.num_updates = 0
        self.episode_rewards = []
        self.episode_lengths = []
        
        # Episode追踪（每个环境）
        self.episode_reward_buffer = [0.0] * config.num_envs
        self.episode_length_buffer = [0] * config.num_envs
        
        # 日志和保存
        self.setup_logging()
    
    def setup_logging(self) -> None:
        """设置日志系统"""
        # 创建目录
        log_dir = Path(self.config.log_dir) / self.config.run_name
        checkpoint_dir = Path(self.config.checkpoint_dir) / self.config.run_name
        result_dir = Path(self.config.result_dir) / self.config.run_name
        
        for dir_path in [log_dir, checkpoint_dir, result_dir]:
            dir_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        
        self.log_dir = log_dir
        self.checkpoint_dir = checkpoint_dir
        self.result_dir = result_dir
        
        # Tensorboard
        self.writer = SummaryWriter(str(log_dir))
        
        logger.info(f"📊 日志系统初始化完成")
        logger.info(f"   Tensorboard: {log_dir}")
        logger.info(f"   Checkpoints: {checkpoint_dir}")
        logger.info(f"   Results: {result_dir}")
    
    def collect_rollouts(self) -> None:
        """
        收集一个rollout的数据（horizon步）
        使用当前策略与环境交互
        """
        # 重置缓冲区
        self.buffer.reset()
        
        # 获取初始观测
        obs, _ = self.env.reset() if self.global_step == 0 else (self.current_obs, None)
        
        # 收集horizon步数据
        for step in range(self.config.horizon):
            # 采样动作
            actions, log_probs, values = self.agent.get_action(obs, deterministic=False)
            
            # 环境交互
            next_obs, rewards, dones, truncated, infos = self.env.step(actions)
            
            # 处理真实的终止（done或truncated）
            real_dones = np.logical_or(dones, truncated)
            
            # 存储到缓冲区
            # 注意：actions需要reshape以匹配缓冲区的期望形状
            if len(actions.shape) == 1:
                actions = actions.reshape(-1, 1)
            
            self.buffer.add(
                obs=obs,
                action=actions,
                reward=rewards,
                value=values,
                log_prob=log_probs,
                done=real_dones.astype(np.float32)
            )
            
            # 更新Episode统计
            for i in range(self.config.num_envs):
                self.episode_reward_buffer[i] += rewards[i]
                self.episode_length_buffer[i] += 1
                
                if real_dones[i]:
                    # Episode结束
                    self.episode_rewards.append(self.episode_reward_buffer[i])
                    self.episode_lengths.append(self.episode_length_buffer[i])
                    
                    # 重置
                    self.episode_reward_buffer[i] = 0.0
                    self.episode_length_buffer[i] = 0
            
            # 更新状态
            obs = next_obs
            self.global_step += self.config.num_envs
        
        # 保存当前观测（下次rollout使用）
        self.current_obs = obs
        
        # 计算优势函数
        # 需要最后一步的next_value
        with torch.no_grad():
            _, _, next_values = self.agent.get_action(obs, deterministic=False)
        
        self.buffer.compute_advantages(next_values)
    
    def train_step(self) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """
        执行一步训练：收集数据 + 更新策略
        
        Returns:
            训练统计信息
        """
        # 1. 收集rollout数据
        self.collect_rollouts()
        
        # 2. 更新策略
        update_info = self.agent.update(self.buffer)
        
        # 3. 更新计数
        self.num_updates += 1
        
        # 4. 添加episode统计
        if len(self.episode_rewards) > 0:
            recent_rewards = self.episode_rewards[-100:]  # 最近100个episode
            update_info["episode_reward_mean"] = np.mean(recent_rewards)
            update_info["episode_reward_std"] = np.std(recent_rewards)
            update_info["episode_length_mean"] = np.mean(self.episode_lengths[-100:])
        
        return update_info
    
    def evaluate(self, num_episodes: int = 10) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """
        评估当前策略
        
        Args:
            num_episodes: 评估的episode数量
            
        Returns:
            评估统计信息
        """
        logger.info(f"🎯 开始评估 ({num_episodes} episodes)...")
        
        eval_rewards = []
        eval_lengths = []
        
        for _ in range(num_episodes):
            obs, _ = self.eval_env.reset()
            done = False
            episode_reward = 0.0
            episode_length = 0
            
            while not done:
                # 使用确定性策略
                obs_batch = obs.reshape(1, -1)
                action, _, _ = self.agent.get_action(obs_batch, deterministic=True)
                
                obs, reward, terminated, truncated, _ = self.eval_env.step(action[0])
                done = terminated or truncated
                
                episode_reward += reward
                episode_length += 1
            
            eval_rewards.append(episode_reward)
            eval_lengths.append(episode_length)
        
        eval_info = {
            "eval_reward_mean": np.mean(eval_rewards),
            "eval_reward_std": np.std(eval_rewards),
            "eval_length_mean": np.mean(eval_lengths),
        }
        
        logger.info(f"   ✅ 评估完成: Reward = {eval_info['eval_reward_mean']:.2f} ± {eval_info['eval_reward_std']:.2f}")
        
        return eval_info
    
    def log_metrics(self, metrics: Dict[str, float], step: int) -> None:
        """记录指标到Tensorboard和日志"""
        for key, value in metrics.items():
            self.writer.add_scalar(key, value, step)
    
    def train(self) -> None:
        """
        完整的训练流程
        """
        logger.info("=" * 60)
        logger.info("🚀 开始训练PPO")
        logger.info(f"   总步数: {self.config.total_timesteps:,}")
        logger.info(f"   更新次数: {self.config.get_num_updates():,}")
        logger.info(f"   Horizon: {self.config.horizon}")
        logger.info(f"   Num Epochs: {self.config.num_epochs}")
        logger.info("=" * 60)
        
        # 重置环境
        self.current_obs, _ = self.env.reset()
        
        # 计算总更新次数
        num_updates = self.config.get_num_updates()
        
        # 训练进度条
        pbar = tqdm(total=num_updates, desc="Training Progress")
        
        # 主训练循环
        start_time = time.time()
        
        for update in range(num_updates):
            # 执行一步训练
            train_info = self.train_step()
            
            # 日志记录
            if (update + 1) % self.config.log_interval == 0:
                # 计算FPS
                elapsed_time = time.time() - start_time
                fps = self.global_step / elapsed_time
                
                train_info["fps"] = fps
                train_info["global_step"] = self.global_step
                
                # 记录到Tensorboard
                self.log_metrics(train_info, self.global_step)
                
                # 更新进度条
                pbar.set_postfix({
                    "reward": f"{train_info.get('episode_reward_mean', 0):.2f}",
                    "fps": f"{fps:.0f}",
                    "kl": f"{train_info.get('approx_kl', 0):.4f}"
                })
            
            # 模型保存
            if (update + 1) % self.config.save_interval == 0:
                save_path = self.checkpoint_dir / f"checkpoint_{self.global_step}.pt"
                self.agent.save(str(save_path))
            
            # 评估
            if (update + 1) % self.config.eval_interval == 0:
                eval_info = self.evaluate(self.config.num_eval_episodes)
                self.log_metrics(eval_info, self.global_step)
            
            pbar.update(1)
        
        pbar.close()
        
        # 训练结束
        logger.info("=" * 60)
        logger.info("✨ 训练完成!")
        logger.info(f"   总用时: {time.time() - start_time:.2f}s")
        logger.info(f"   总步数: {self.global_step:,}")
        logger.info(f"   平均Reward: {np.mean(self.episode_rewards[-100:]):.2f}")
        logger.info("=" * 60)
        
        # 保存最终模型
        final_path = self.checkpoint_dir / "final_model.pt"
        self.agent.save(str(final_path))
        
        # 最终评估
        logger.info("🎯 执行最终评估...")
        final_eval = self.evaluate(num_episodes=100)
        self.log_metrics(final_eval, self.global_step)
        
        # 关闭环境和Writer
        self.env.close()
        self.eval_env.close()
        self.writer.close()
        
        logger.info("🎉 所有任务完成!")


def train_ppo(
    config: PPOConfig,
    device: str = "auto"
) -> PPOTrainer:
    """
    便捷的训练函数
    
    Args:
        config: PPO配置
        device: 设备 (auto/cpu/cuda)
        
    Returns:
        训练好的Trainer对象
    """
    # 自动选择设备
    if device == "auto":
        import torch
        device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
    
    # 创建Trainer并训练
    trainer = PPOTrainer(config, device=device)
    trainer.train()
    
    return trainer

import json
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Dict, Callable, Optional
from dataclasses import asdict
from loguru import logger
import numpy as np

from configs.base_config import PPOConfig, PPOVariant, get_mujoco_config, get_atari_config
from training.trainer import train_ppo


class ExperimentFactory:
    """
    实验工厂类
    提供创建、运行和管理批量实验的工具
    """
    
    def __init__(self, base_result_dir: str = "./results"):
        """
        Args:
            base_result_dir: 结果保存根目录
        """
        self.base_result_dir = Path(base_result_dir)
        self.base_result_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        
        logger.info(f"🏭 实验工厂初始化完成")
        logger.info(f"   结果目录: {base_result_dir}")
    
    # ========== 论文实验复现 ==========
    
    def create_baseline_experiments(self) -> Dict[str, PPOConfig]:
        """
        创建基线实验配置（论文中的主要方法）
        
        Returns:
            实验配置字典
        """
        configs = {}
        
        # 标准环境列表
        envs = [
            "HalfCheetah-v4",
            "Hopper-v4", 
            "Walker2d-v4",
            "Swimmer-v4",
            "Ant-v4"
        ]
        
        for env_name in envs:
            config = get_mujoco_config(env_name)
            config.experiment_name = f"baseline_{env_name}"
            config.total_timesteps = 1_000_000  # 1M步
            configs[f"baseline_{env_name}"] = config
        
        return configs
    
    def create_ablation_experiments(
        self,
        base_env: str = "HalfCheetah-v4"
    ) -> Dict[str, PPOConfig]:
        """
        创建消融实验配置（复现论文Table 1）
        系统性地移除各个组件以验证其重要性
        
        Args:
            base_env: 基础环境名称
            
        Returns:
            实验配置字典
        """
        base_config = get_mujoco_config(base_env)
        configs = {}
        
        # 1. 完整PPO (Clipped) - 基线
        full_config = get_mujoco_config(base_env)
        full_config.experiment_name = f"ablation_full_ppo"
        configs["full_ppo"] = full_config
        
        # 2. 无Clipping
        no_clip = PPOConfig(**asdict(base_config))
        no_clip.ppo_variant = PPOVariant.NO_CLIP_NO_PENALTY
        no_clip.experiment_name = "ablation_no_clip"
        configs["no_clip"] = no_clip
        
        # 3. 无Value Function Clipping
        no_value_clip = PPOConfig(**asdict(base_config))
        no_value_clip.clip_value_loss = False
        no_value_clip.experiment_name = "ablation_no_value_clip"
        configs["no_value_clip"] = no_value_clip
        
        # 4. 无熵正则化
        no_entropy = PPOConfig(**asdict(base_config))
        no_entropy.entropy_coef = 0.0
        no_entropy.experiment_name = "ablation_no_entropy"
        configs["no_entropy"] = no_entropy
        
        # 5. 固定KL惩罚
        kl_fixed = PPOConfig(**asdict(base_config))
        kl_fixed.ppo_variant = PPOVariant.KL_PENALTY_FIXED
        kl_fixed.experiment_name = "ablation_kl_fixed"
        configs["kl_fixed"] = kl_fixed
        
        # 6. 自适应KL惩罚
        kl_adaptive = PPOConfig(**asdict(base_config))
        kl_adaptive.ppo_variant = PPOVariant.KL_PENALTY_ADAPTIVE
        kl_adaptive.experiment_name = "ablation_kl_adaptive"
        configs["kl_adaptive"] = kl_adaptive
        
        # 7. 不同的Clip值测试
        for epsilon in [0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.3]:
            clip_test = PPOConfig(**asdict(base_config))
            clip_test.clip_epsilon = epsilon
            clip_test.experiment_name = f"ablation_clip_{epsilon}"
            configs[f"clip_{epsilon}"] = clip_test
        
        return configs
    
    def create_hyperparameter_search(
        self,
        env_name: str = "HalfCheetah-v4"
    ) -> Dict[str, PPOConfig]:
        """
        创建超参数搜索实验
        
        Args:
            env_name: 环境名称
            
        Returns:
            实验配置字典
        """
        base_config = get_mujoco_config(env_name)
        configs = {}
        
        # 学习率搜索
        for lr in [1e-4, 3e-4, 1e-3, 3e-3]:
            config = PPOConfig(**asdict(base_config))
            config.learning_rate = lr
            config.experiment_name = f"hp_lr_{lr}"
            configs[f"lr_{lr}"] = config
        
        # GAE lambda搜索
        for lam in [0.90, 0.95, 0.98, 1.0]:
            config = PPOConfig(**asdict(base_config))
            config.gae_lambda = lam
            config.experiment_name = f"hp_lambda_{lam}"
            configs[f"lambda_{lam}"] = config
        
        # Horizon搜索
        for horizon in [1024, 2048, 4096]:
            config = PPOConfig(**asdict(base_config))
            config.horizon = horizon
            config.experiment_name = f"hp_horizon_{horizon}"
            configs[f"horizon_{horizon}"] = config
        
        return configs
    
    def create_scaling_experiments(self) -> Dict[str, PPOConfig]:
        """
        创建规模化实验（不同环境数量）
        
        Returns:
            实验配置字典
        """
        configs = {}
        
        for num_envs in [1, 4, 8, 16]:
            config = get_mujoco_config("HalfCheetah-v4")
            config.num_envs = num_envs
            config.experiment_name = f"scaling_{num_envs}_envs"
            configs[f"{num_envs}_envs"] = config
        
        return configs
    
    # ========== 实验运行 ==========
    
    def run_single_experiment(
        self,
        config: PPOConfig,
        seed: Optional[int] = None,
        device: str = "auto"
    ) -> Dict[str, any]:
        """
        运行单个实验
        
        Args:
            config: 实验配置
            seed: 随机种子（覆盖config中的seed）
            device: 计算设备
            
        Returns:
            实验结果
        """
        if seed is not None:
            config.seed = seed
            config.run_name = f"{config.experiment_name}_seed{seed}"
        
        logger.info("=" * 70)
        logger.info(f"🧪 开始实验: {config.experiment_name}")
        logger.info(f"   种子: {config.seed}")
        logger.info(f"   环境: {config.env_name}")
        logger.info(f"   变体: {config.ppo_variant.value}")
        logger.info("=" * 70)
        
        # 记录开始时间
        start_time = time.time()
        
        try:
            # 训练
            trainer = train_ppo(config, device=device)
            
            # 收集结果
            results = {
                "experiment_name": config.experiment_name,
                "seed": config.seed,
                "config": config.to_dict(),
                "training_time": time.time() - start_time,
                "episode_rewards": trainer.episode_rewards,
                "episode_lengths": trainer.episode_lengths,
                "final_reward_mean": np.mean(trainer.episode_rewards[-100:]),
                "final_reward_std": np.std(trainer.episode_rewards[-100:]),
                "success": True,
            }
            
            # 保存结果
            result_path = self.base_result_dir / f"{config.run_name}_results.json"
            with open(result_path, 'w') as f:
                json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
            
            logger.info(f"✅ 实验完成: {config.experiment_name}")
            logger.info(f"   最终Reward: {results['final_reward_mean']:.2f} ± {results['final_reward_std']:.2f}")
            logger.info(f"   用时: {results['training_time']:.2f}s")
            
            return results
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"❌ 实验失败: {config.experiment_name}")
            logger.error(f"   错误: {str(e)}")
            
            return {
                "experiment_name": config.experiment_name,
                "seed": config.seed,
                "success": False,
                "error": str(e),
            }
    
    def run_experiment_suite(
        self,
        configs: Dict[str, PPOConfig],
        n_seeds: int = 3,
        device: str = "auto"
    ) -> Dict[str, List[Dict]]:
        """
        运行一组实验（多个种子）
        
        Args:
            configs: 实验配置字典
            n_seeds: 每个配置运行的种子数
            device: 计算设备
            
        Returns:
            所有实验结果
        """
        logger.info("🎯 开始运行实验套件")
        logger.info(f"   实验数量: {len(configs)}")
        logger.info(f"   每个实验种子数: {n_seeds}")
        logger.info(f"   总运行次数: {len(configs) * n_seeds}")
        
        all_results = {}
        
        for exp_name, config in configs.items():
            logger.info(f"\n📌 运行实验组: {exp_name}")
            
            exp_results = []
            
            for seed in range(n_seeds):
                result = self.run_single_experiment(
                    config=config,
                    seed=seed,
                    device=device
                )
                exp_results.append(result)
            
            all_results[exp_name] = exp_results
            
            # 计算该实验组的统计
            if all(r["success"] for r in exp_results):
                mean_rewards = [r["final_reward_mean"] for r in exp_results]
                logger.info(f"📊 {exp_name} 统计:")
                logger.info(f"   平均Reward: {np.mean(mean_rewards):.2f} ± {np.std(mean_rewards):.2f}")
        
        # 保存汇总结果
        summary_path = self.base_result_dir / "experiment_suite_summary.json"
        with open(summary_path, 'w') as f:
            json.dump(all_results, f, indent=2)
        
        logger.info(f"\n✨ 实验套件完成!")
        logger.info(f"   结果已保存到: {summary_path}")
        
        return all_results
    
    # ========== 快捷方法 ==========
    
    def run_baseline_suite(
        self,
        n_seeds: int = 3,
        device: str = "auto"
    ) -> Dict[str, List[Dict]]:
        """运行基线实验套件"""
        configs = self.create_baseline_experiments()
        return self.run_experiment_suite(configs, n_seeds, device)
    
    def run_ablation_suite(
        self,
        env_name: str = "HalfCheetah-v4",
        n_seeds: int = 3,
        device: str = "auto"
    ) -> Dict[str, List[Dict]]:
        """运行消融实验套件"""
        configs = self.create_ablation_experiments(env_name)
        return self.run_experiment_suite(configs, n_seeds, device)
    
    def run_hyperparameter_search(
        self,
        env_name: str = "HalfCheetah-v4",
        n_seeds: int = 3,
        device: str = "auto"
    ) -> Dict[str, List[Dict]]:
        """运行超参数搜索"""
        configs = self.create_hyperparameter_search(env_name)
        return self.run_experiment_suite(configs, n_seeds, device)


# ========== 便捷函数 ==========

def quick_ablation_study(
    env_name: str = "HalfCheetah-v4",
    n_seeds: int = 3,
    device: str = "auto"
) -> Dict[str, List[Dict]]:
    """
    快速运行消融研究
    
    Args:
        env_name: 环境名称
        n_seeds: 种子数
        device: 设备
        
    Returns:
        实验结果
    """
    factory = ExperimentFactory()
    return factory.run_ablation_suite(env_name, n_seeds, device)

"""

复现论文中的关键图表

Author: PPO Research Team

import json
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Optional
import seaborn as sns

# 设置绘图风格
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.rcParams['figure.figsize'] = (10, 6)
plt.rcParams['font.size'] = 12


def plot_clipped_surrogate_objective(
    save_path: Optional[str] = None
) -> None:
    """
    绘制Clipped Surrogate Objective函数
    复现论文Figure 1
    
    Args:
        save_path: 保存路径
    """
    # 生成数据
    r_values = np.linspace(0, 3, 500)  # 概率比 r = π/π_old
    epsilon = 0.2
    
    # 假设优势为正
    A_positive = 1.0
    L_clip_positive = np.minimum(
        r_values * A_positive,
        np.clip(r_values, 1 - epsilon, 1 + epsilon) * A_positive
    )
    
    # 假设优势为负
    A_negative = -1.0
    L_clip_negative = np.minimum(
        r_values * A_negative,
        np.clip(r_values, 1 - epsilon, 1 + epsilon) * A_negative
    )
    
    # 绘图
    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5))
    
    # 左图：正优势
    ax1.plot(r_values, r_values * A_positive, 'b--', label='Unclipped', linewidth=2)
    ax1.plot(r_values, L_clip_positive, 'r-', label='Clipped', linewidth=2)
    ax1.axvline(x=1-epsilon, color='gray', linestyle=':', alpha=0.7)
    ax1.axvline(x=1+epsilon, color='gray', linestyle=':', alpha=0.7)
    ax1.axvline(x=1, color='black', linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)
    ax1.set_xlabel('Probability Ratio r = π/π_old', fontsize=13)
    ax1.set_ylabel('Surrogate Objective', fontsize=13)
    ax1.set_title(f'Positive Advantage (A > 0)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
    ax1.legend(fontsize=11)
    ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
    
    # 右图：负优势
    ax2.plot(r_values, r_values * A_negative, 'b--', label='Unclipped', linewidth=2)
    ax2.plot(r_values, L_clip_negative, 'r-', label='Clipped', linewidth=2)
    ax2.axvline(x=1-epsilon, color='gray', linestyle=':', alpha=0.7)
    ax2.axvline(x=1+epsilon, color='gray', linestyle=':', alpha=0.7)
    ax2.axvline(x=1, color='black', linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)
    ax2.set_xlabel('Probability Ratio r = π/π_old', fontsize=13)
    ax2.set_ylabel('Surrogate Objective', fontsize=13)
    ax2.set_title(f'Negative Advantage (A < 0)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
    ax2.legend(fontsize=11)
    ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
    
    plt.suptitle('PPO Clipped Surrogate Objective (ε=0.2)', 
                 fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
    plt.tight_layout()
    
    if save_path:
        plt.savefig(save_path, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
        print(f"✅ 图片已保存到: {save_path}")
    
    plt.show()


def plot_training_curves(
    results_dict: Dict[str, List[Dict]],
    metric: str = "episode_rewards",
    smooth_window: int = 10,
    save_path: Optional[str] = None
) -> None:
    """
    绘制训练曲线对比图
    
    Args:
        results_dict: 实验结果字典 {exp_name: [result1, result2, ...]}
        metric: 要绘制的指标
        smooth_window: 平滑窗口大小
        save_path: 保存路径
    """
    plt.figure(figsize=(12, 7))
    
    for exp_name, results in results_dict.items():
        # 收集所有种子的数据
        all_rewards = []
        max_length = 0
        
        for result in results:
            if result["success"] and metric in result:
                rewards = result[metric]
                all_rewards.append(rewards)
                max_length = max(max_length, len(rewards))
        
        if not all_rewards:
            continue
        
        # 对齐长度（填充）
        aligned_rewards = []
        for rewards in all_rewards:
            if len(rewards) < max_length:
                # 用最后一个值填充
                padded = np.pad(rewards, (0, max_length - len(rewards)), 
                              mode='edge')
            else:
                padded = np.array(rewards)
            aligned_rewards.append(padded)
        
        aligned_rewards = np.array(aligned_rewards)
        
        # 计算均值和标准差
        mean_rewards = np.mean(aligned_rewards, axis=0)
        std_rewards = np.std(aligned_rewards, axis=0)
        
        # 平滑
        def smooth(data, window):
            if window <= 1:
                return data
            return np.convolve(data, np.ones(window)/window, mode='valid')
        
        mean_smooth = smooth(mean_rewards, smooth_window)
        std_smooth = smooth(std_rewards, smooth_window)
        
        x = np.arange(len(mean_smooth))
        
        # 绘制曲线
        plt.plot(x, mean_smooth, label=exp_name, linewidth=2)
        plt.fill_between(x, 
                        mean_smooth - std_smooth,
                        mean_smooth + std_smooth,
                        alpha=0.2)
    
    plt.xlabel('Episode', fontsize=13)
    plt.ylabel('Reward', fontsize=13)
    plt.title('Training Curves Comparison', fontsize=15, fontweight='bold')
    plt.legend(fontsize=10)
    plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
    plt.tight_layout()
    
    if save_path:
        plt.savefig(save_path, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
        print(f"✅ 图片已保存到: {save_path}")
    
    plt.show()


def plot_ablation_comparison(
    results_path: str,
    save_path: Optional[str] = None
) -> None:
    """
    绘制消融实验对比图（类似论文Table 1）
    
    Args:
        results_path: 实验结果JSON路径
        save_path: 保存路径
    """
    # 加载结果
    with open(results_path, 'r') as f:
        results = json.load(f)
    
    # 提取数据
    exp_names = []
    mean_rewards = []
    std_rewards = []
    
    for exp_name, exp_results in results.items():
        if all(r["success"] for r in exp_results):
            exp_names.append(exp_name)
            
            rewards = [r["final_reward_mean"] for r in exp_results]
            mean_rewards.append(np.mean(rewards))
            std_rewards.append(np.std(rewards))
    
    # 按性能排序
    sorted_indices = np.argsort(mean_rewards)[::-1]
    exp_names = [exp_names[i] for i in sorted_indices]
    mean_rewards = [mean_rewards[i] for i in sorted_indices]
    std_rewards = [std_rewards[i] for i in sorted_indices]
    
    # 绘制条形图
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 8))
    
    y_pos = np.arange(len(exp_names))
    colors = plt.cm.viridis(np.linspace(0.3, 0.9, len(exp_names)))
    
    bars = ax.barh(y_pos, mean_rewards, xerr=std_rewards, 
                   color=colors, alpha=0.8, capsize=5)
    
    ax.set_yticks(y_pos)
    ax.set_yticklabels(exp_names, fontsize=11)
    ax.set_xlabel('Final Reward (Mean ± Std)', fontsize=13)
    ax.set_title('Ablation Study Results', fontsize=15, fontweight='bold')
    ax.grid(True, axis='x', alpha=0.3)
    
    # 添加数值标签
    for i, (mean, std) in enumerate(zip(mean_rewards, std_rewards)):
        ax.text(mean + std + 50, i, f'{mean:.1f}±{std:.1f}',
                va='center', fontsize=10)
    
    plt.tight_layout()
    
    if save_path:
        plt.savefig(save_path, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
        print(f"✅ 图片已保存到: {save_path}")
    
    plt.show()


def plot_hyperparameter_heatmap(
    results_path: str,
    param1: str = "learning_rate",
    param2: str = "gae_lambda",
    save_path: Optional[str] = None
) -> None:
    """
    绘制超参数搜索热力图
    
    Args:
        results_path: 实验结果路径
        param1: 第一个参数名
        param2: 第二个参数名
        save_path: 保存路径
    """
    # 加载结果
    with open(results_path, 'r') as f:
        results = json.load(f)
    
    # 提取参数值和性能
    param1_values = set()
    param2_values = set()
    performance_matrix = {}
    
    for exp_name, exp_results in results.items():
        if not all(r["success"] for r in exp_results):
            continue
        
        # 从配置中提取参数
        config = exp_results[0]["config"]
        p1_val = config.get(param1)
        p2_val = config.get(param2)
        
        if p1_val is not None and p2_val is not None:
            param1_values.add(p1_val)
            param2_values.add(p2_val)
            
            # 平均性能
            rewards = [r["final_reward_mean"] for r in exp_results]
            performance_matrix[(p1_val, p2_val)] = np.mean(rewards)
    
    # 创建矩阵
    param1_sorted = sorted(param1_values)
    param2_sorted = sorted(param2_values)
    
    matrix = np.zeros((len(param2_sorted), len(param1_sorted)))
    
    for i, p2 in enumerate(param2_sorted):
        for j, p1 in enumerate(param1_sorted):
            if (p1, p2) in performance_matrix:
                matrix[i, j] = performance_matrix[(p1, p2)]
            else:
                matrix[i, j] = np.nan
    
    # 绘制热力图
    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
    sns.heatmap(matrix, annot=True, fmt='.1f', cmap='YlOrRd',
                xticklabels=[f'{v:.0e}' for v in param1_sorted],
                yticklabels=[f'{v:.2f}' for v in param2_sorted],
                cbar_kws={'label': 'Final Reward'})
    
    plt.xlabel(param1.replace('_', ' ').title(), fontsize=13)
    plt.ylabel(param2.replace('_', ' ').title(), fontsize=13)
    plt.title('Hyperparameter Search Results', fontsize=15, fontweight='bold')
    plt.tight_layout()
    
    if save_path:
        plt.savefig(save_path, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
        print(f"✅ 图片已保存到: {save_path}")
    
    plt.show()


def create_paper_figures(output_dir: str = "./figures"):
    """
    生成所有论文图表
    
    Args:
        output_dir: 输出目录
    """
    output_path = Path(output_dir)
    output_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    
    print("📊 生成论文图表...")
    
    # Figure 1: Clipped Objective
    print("\n1️⃣ 绘制Clipped Surrogate Objective...")
    plot_clipped_surrogate_objective(
        save_path=str(output_path / "figure1_clipped_objective.png")
    )
    
    print("\n✨ 所有图表生成完成!")
    print(f"   保存位置: {output_path}")

"""
日志系统配置
整合Loguru和Tensorboard，提供统一的日志接口

Author: PPO Research Team
Date: 2025-10-18
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional
from loguru import logger
from torch.utils.tensorboard import SummaryWriter


class PPOLogger:
    """
    PPO专用日志器
    整合Loguru（文本日志）和Tensorboard（可视化）
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        log_dir: str,
        experiment_name: str,
        enable_tensorboard: bool = True,
        console_level: str = "INFO",
        file_level: str = "DEBUG"
    ):
        """
        Args:
            log_dir: 日志目录
            experiment_name: 实验名称
            enable_tensorboard: 是否启用Tensorboard
            console_level: 控制台日志级别
            file_level: 文件日志级别
        """
        self.log_dir = Path(log_dir)
        self.log_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        
        self.experiment_name = experiment_name
        self.log_file = self.log_dir / f"{experiment_name}.log"
        
        # 配置Loguru
        self._setup_loguru(console_level, file_level)
        
        # 配置Tensorboard
        self.enable_tensorboard = enable_tensorboard
        if enable_tensorboard:
            self.writer = SummaryWriter(str(self.log_dir))
        else:
            self.writer = None
        
        logger.info(f"📝 日志系统初始化完成")
        logger.info(f"   实验名称: {experiment_name}")
        logger.info(f"   日志文件: {self.log_file}")
        if enable_tensorboard:
            logger.info(f"   Tensorboard: {self.log_dir}")
    
    def _setup_loguru(self, console_level: str, file_level: str) -> None:
        """配置Loguru日志器"""
        # 移除默认handler
        logger.remove()
        
        # 添加控制台handler（带颜色）
        logger.add(
            sys.stderr,
            level=console_level,
            format="<green>{time:YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss}</green> | "
                   "<level>{level: <8}</level> | "
                   "<cyan>{name}</cyan>:<cyan>{function}</cyan>:<cyan>{line}</cyan> | "
                   "<level>{message}</level>",
            colorize=True
        )
        
        # 添加文件handler（详细日志）
        logger.add(
            str(self.log_file),
            level=file_level,
            format="{time:YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss} | {level: <8} | {name}:{function}:{line} | {message}",
            rotation="100 MB",  # 日志文件达到100MB时轮转
            retention="30 days",  # 保留30天
            compression="zip"  # 压缩旧日志
        )
    
    def log_scalar(
        self, 
        tag: str, 
        value: float, 
        step: int
    ) -> None:
        """
        记录标量值
        
        Args:
            tag: 标签名
            value: 值
            step: 步数
        """
        if self.writer is not None:
            self.writer.add_scalar(tag, value, step)
    
    def log_scalars(
        self,
        main_tag: str,
        tag_scalar_dict: dict,
        step: int
    ) -> None:
        """
        记录多个标量值
        
        Args:
            main_tag: 主标签
            tag_scalar_dict: {子标签: 值}
            step: 步数
        """
        if self.writer is not None:
            self.writer.add_scalars(main_tag, tag_scalar_dict, step)
    
    def log_histogram(
        self,
        tag: str,
        values,
        step: int
    ) -> None:
        """
        记录直方图
        
        Args:
            tag: 标签名
            values: 数值数组
            step: 步数
        """
        if self.writer is not None:
            self.writer.add_histogram(tag, values, step)
    
    def log_training_metrics(
        self,
        metrics: dict,
        step: int,
        prefix: str = "train"
    ) -> None:
        """
        记录训练指标
        
        Args:
            metrics: 指标字典
            step: 步数
            prefix: 前缀
        """
        # 记录到Tensorboard
        for key, value in metrics.items():
            if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
                self.log_scalar(f"{prefix}/{key}", value, step)
        
        # 打印关键指标到控制台
        if "episode_reward_mean" in metrics:
            logger.info(
                f"Step {step:,} | "
                f"Reward: {metrics['episode_reward_mean']:.2f} | "
                f"Loss: {metrics.get('total_loss', 0):.4f} | "
                f"KL: {metrics.get('approx_kl', 0):.4f}"
            )
    
    def log_hyperparameters(self, hparams: dict, metrics: dict) -> None:
        """
        记录超参数和对应指标
        
        Args:
            hparams: 超参数字典
            metrics: 指标字典
        """
        if self.writer is not None:
            self.writer.add_hparams(hparams, metrics)
    
    def close(self) -> None:
        """关闭日志器"""
        if self.writer is not None:
            self.writer.close()
        logger.info("📝 日志系统已关闭")


def setup_logger(
    log_dir: str = "./logs",
    experiment_name: str = "ppo_experiment",
    console_level: str = "INFO"
) -> PPOLogger:
    """
    快速设置日志器的便捷函数
    
    Args:
        log_dir: 日志目录
        experiment_name: 实验名称
        console_level: 控制台日志级别
        
    Returns:
        配置好的PPOLogger
    """
    return PPOLogger(
        log_dir=log_dir,
        experiment_name=experiment_name,
        console_level=console_level
    )


# ========== 日志装饰器 ==========

def log_execution_time(func):
    """记录函数执行时间的装饰器"""
    import time
    from functools import wraps
    
    @wraps(func)
    def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
        start_time = time.time()
        logger.info(f"⏱️  开始执行: {func.__name__}")
        
        result = func(*args, **kwargs)
        
        elapsed = time.time() - start_time
        logger.info(f"✅ 完成: {func.__name__} (用时: {elapsed:.2f}s)")
        
        return result
    
    return wrapper


def log_exceptions(func):
    """记录异常的装饰器"""
    from functools import wraps
    
    @wraps(func)
    def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
        try:
            return func(*args, **kwargs)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"❌ 函数 {func.__name__} 发生异常: {str(e)}")
            raise
    
    return wrapper


# ========== 进度条集成 ==========

class TqdmLoguruHandler:
    """
    让Loguru和tqdm进度条兼容的Handler
    """
    
    def write(self, message):
        from tqdm import tqdm
        tqdm.write(message, end="")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # 测试日志系统
    test_logger = setup_logger(
        log_dir="./test_logs",
        experiment_name="test_experiment"
    )
    
    # 测试不同级别的日志
    logger.debug("这是DEBUG级别")
    logger.info("这是INFO级别")
    logger.warning("这是WARNING级别")
    logger.error("这是ERROR级别")
    
    # 测试Tensorboard记录
    test_logger.log_scalar("test/reward", 100.5, 0)
    test_logger.log_scalars("test/losses", {
        "policy_loss": 0.5,
        "value_loss": 0.3
    }, 0)
    
    # 测试装饰器
    @log_execution_time
    @log_exceptions
    def test_function():
        import time
        time.sleep(1)
        return "完成"
    
    result = test_function()
    
    test_logger.close()
    print("\n✅ 日志系统测试完成!")

    plot_clipped_surrogate_objective,
    plot_ablation_comparison,
    create_paper_figures
)


def train_command(args):
    """训练命令"""
    logger.info("🚀 开始训练...")
    
    # 创建配置
    if args.config_type == "mujoco":
        config = get_mujoco_config(args.env)
    elif args.config_type == "atari":
        config = get_atari_config(args.env)
    else:
        config = PPOConfig(env_name=args.env)
    
    # 覆盖参数
    if args.variant:
        config.ppo_variant = PPOVariant(args.variant)
    if args.timesteps:
        config.total_timesteps = args.timesteps
    if args.seed:
        config.seed = args.seed
    if args.lr:
        config.learning_rate = args.lr
    if args.clip:
        config.clip_epsilon = args.clip
    if args.num_envs:
        config.num_envs = args.num_envs
    
    config.experiment_name = args.name or f"train_{args.env}"
    
    # 训练
    trainer = train_ppo(config, device=args.device)
    
    logger.info("✨ 训练完成!")
    return trainer


def eval_command(args):
    """评估命令"""
    logger.info("🎯 开始评估...")
    
    # TODO: 实现模型加载和评估
    logger.warning("评估功能待实现")


def ablation_command(args):
    """消融实验命令"""
    logger.info("🧪 开始消融实验...")
    
    factory = ExperimentFactory(base_result_dir=args.output_dir)
    
    if args.suite == "baseline":
        results = factory.run_baseline_suite(
            n_seeds=args.n_seeds,
            device=args.device
        )

        )
    else:
        logger.error(f"未知的实验套件: {args.suite}")
        return
    
    logger.info("✨ 消融实验完成!")
    return results


def visualize_command(args):
    """可视化命令"""

    output_dir = args.output_dir or "./figures"
    
    if args.plot_type == "clipped_loss":
        # 绘制Clipped Objective

    elif args.plot_type == "ablation":

    logger.info("✨ 可视化完成!")


def main():
    """主函数"""
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="PPO (Proximal Policy Optimization) - 工业级实现",
        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,
        epilog="""
示例用法:
  # 训练单个模型
  python main.py train --env HalfCheetah-v4 --timesteps 1000000
  
  # 运行消融实验

  # 生成可视化
  python main.py visualize --plot-type clipped_loss

        """
    )
    
    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", help="命令")

    train_parser.add_argument("--config-type", type=str, default="mujoco",

    train_parser.add_argument("--variant", type=str, default="clip",
                             choices=["clip", "kl_fixed", "kl_adaptive", "no_clip"],
                             help="PPO变体")
    train_parser.add_argument("--timesteps", type=int, default=None,
                             help="总训练步数")
    train_parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=None,
                             help="随机种子")
    train_parser.add_argument("--lr", type=float, default=None,
                             help="学习率")
    train_parser.add_argument("--clip", type=float, default=None,

    train_parser.add_argument("--num-envs", type=int, default=None,

    train_parser.add_argument("--name", type=str, default=None,

    train_parser.add_argument("--device", type=str, default="auto",

    # ========== Eval命令 ==========
    eval_parser = subparsers.add_parser("eval", help="评估训练好的模型")

                            help="模型checkpoint路径")
    eval_parser.add_argument("--env", type=str, required=True,
                            help="环境名称")
    eval_parser.add_argument("--episodes", type=int, default=10,
                            help="评估episode数")
    eval_parser.add_argument("--render", action="store_true",
                            help="是否渲染")
    eval_parser.add_argument("--device", type=str, default="auto",
                            help="设备")
    
    # ========== Ablation命令 ==========
    ablation_parser = subparsers.add_parser("ablation", help="运行消融实验")
    ablation_parser.add_argument("--suite", type=str, required=True,
                                choices=["baseline", "ablation", "hyperparameter"],
                                help="实验套件类型")
    ablation_parser.add_argument("--env", type=str, default="HalfCheetah-v4",
                                help="环境名称")
    ablation_parser.add_argument("--n-seeds", type=int, default=3,
                                help="每个配置的种子数")
    ablation_parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=str, default="./results",
                                help="结果输出目录")
    ablation_parser.add_argument("--device", type=str, default="auto",
                                help="设备")
    
    # ========== Visualize命令 ==========
    viz_parser = subparsers.add_parser("visualize", help="生成可视化图表")
    viz_parser.add_argument("--plot-type", type=str, required=True,
                           choices=["clipped_loss", "ablation", "training", "all"],
                           help="图表类型")
    viz_parser.add_argument("--results-file", type=str, default=None,
                           help="实验结果JSON文件路径")
    viz_parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=str, default="./figures",
                           help="图片输出目录")
    
    # 解析参数
    args = parser.parse_args()
    
    if not args.command:
        parser.print_help()
        return
    
    # 执行命令
    if args.command == "train":
        train_command(args)
    elif args.command == "eval":
        eval_command(args)
    elif args.command == "ablation":
        ablation_command(args)
    elif args.command == "visualize":
        visualize_command(args)
    else:
        logger.error(f"未知命令: {args.command}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # 配置日志

        sys.stderr,
        level="INFO",
        format="<green>{time:HH:mm:ss}</green> | <level>{level: <8}</level> | <level>{message}</level>"
    )
    
    try:
